declarations.type:
∀ (Edge : Nat → Nat → Prop)
  (edgeCost :
    {source target : Nat} →
      Edge source target → ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.PathLocalCost)
  (node : Nat),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.PathLocalCostOf (fun {source target} => edgeCost)
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteEvidenceGraphShortestPathFrontierCompleteness.EvidencePath.stay node) =
    ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.ZeroPathLocalCost
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.stay_path_has_zero_local_cost

declarations.type:
∀ {Edge : Nat → Nat → Prop}
  (edgeCost :
    {source target : Nat} →
      Edge source target → ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.PathLocalCost)
  {source next target : Nat} (edge : Edge source next)
  (tail : ASPProof.SearchRouteEvidenceGraphShortestPathFrontierCompleteness.EvidencePath Edge next target),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.PathLocalCostOf (fun {source target} => edgeCost)
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteEvidenceGraphShortestPathFrontierCompleteness.EvidencePath.step edge tail) =
    ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.AddPathLocalCost
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.PathLocalCostOf (fun {source target} => edgeCost)
        tail)
      (edgeCost edge)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.step_path_accumulates_local_cost

declarations.type:
∀ {Edge : Nat → Nat → Prop} {source target : Nat}
  (path : ASPProof.SearchRouteEvidenceGraphShortestPathFrontierCompleteness.EvidencePath Edge source target)
  (pathLocal : ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.PathLocalCost)
  (schedule : ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.ExecutionScheduleCost),
  (ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.AssemblePathRouteCost path pathLocal
        schedule).graphHops =
    path.hopCount
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.assembled_path_route_derives_graph_hops

declarations.type:
∀ (baseHops cycleHops : Nat)
  (baseLocal cycleLocal : ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.PathLocalCost)
  (withoutCycle withCycle : ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.ExecutionScheduleCost),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.ExecutionNoWorse withoutCycle withCycle →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.NoWorse
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.AssembleRouteCostFromParts baseHops baseLocal
        withoutCycle)
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.AssembleRouteCostFromParts (baseHops + cycleHops)
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.AddPathLocalCost baseLocal cycleLocal) withCycle)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.full_route_cycle_removal_requires_schedule_monotonicity

declarations.type:
∀ (baseHops cycleHops : Nat)
  (baseLocal cycleLocal : ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.PathLocalCost)
  (withoutCycle withCycle : ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.ExecutionScheduleCost),
  0 < cycleHops →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.ExecutionNoWorse withoutCycle withCycle →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.StrictlyDominates
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.AssembleRouteCostFromParts baseHops baseLocal
          withoutCycle)
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.AssembleRouteCostFromParts (baseHops + cycleHops)
          (ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.AddPathLocalCost baseLocal cycleLocal)
          withCycle)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteMultiobjectivePathCostFrontierTermination.positive_hop_cycle_removal_strictly_dominates
